messages.subject: geom_bar (postion=stat)
parts:
Hello,

I have used the following code [geom_bar (position="identitiy") ...]
to plot a bar chart to show how the [precalculated] estimate (y) that
varies by age (x) compares between race (fill) - A and B are the
levels of race (fill). The goal is to show the ages (x) at which the
estimate (y) for Group A exceeds that of Group B or vice-versa.

ggplot gives me a chart in which each and every bar has a portion that
is colored the same (dark green - intersection?) and the remaining
portiont is colored either (blue) or (red).

Issue: The bar gives the legend.text as follows: Group A for "blue"
and Group B for "red". But, there is no legend.text for "dark green".

What does "dark green" of the bar map? Is that not the intersection
of Groups A and B?

Thanks,

Pradip


#######################################################
p <- ggplot(single_yr, aes(y=percent, x=age, fill=Race))+
geom_bar(position = "identity", alpha=0.3) +
ylim (0,12)+
scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Age")+
ylab("Percentage")+

opts(legend.direction="horizontal",
title=" ",
axis.title.y = theme_text(angle=90, face = 'bold', size =
16),
axis.title.x=theme_text(vjust=1, size=16, face="bold"),
axis.text.y=theme_text(size=16, hjust=1, face="bold"),
axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=90, hjust=1, size=16,
face="bold"),
strip.text.x = theme_text (size=24, face="bold"),
#panel.background=theme_rect(),
plot.title = theme_text(size=1,
face="bold")
)
